note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The proper page prints cæléstibus, retained in the selected text; the pinned digital source uses the alternative ligature œ.
The printed conclusion in Rubricae generales 115 a uses Iesum, retained in the selected text; the pinned digital conclusion uses consonantal J.
The printed conclusion in Rubricae generales 115 a has no comma after Christum, as retained in the selected text. The pinned digital conclusion adds a comma without changing the words.

The selected expanded conclusion retains house capitalization after its colon. The pinned digital conclusion has lowercase qui; the rubric also prints lowercase qui after tuum, rather than the house tuum: Qui.
The printed conclusion in Rubricae generales 115 a has a comma after Sancti, retained in the selected text. The pinned digital conclusion has no comma there.
